en.t: AI makes it very easy to ask for "one more version."
en.d: Ten options become twenty. Soon you're comparing tiny differences and forgetting what you wanted in the first place. I think the brief needs a finish line: who this is for, what it should communicate, and what makes it ready to publish. Otherwise, generating becomes a way to postpone choosing. How do you decide when something is ready? #AI #GenerativeAI…
